text: The applicant proved to be a rude-looking carter well coated with mud. “Well, my good fellow, what is it?” asked Tommy. “Might this be for you, sir?” The carter held out a very dirty folded note, on the outside of which was written: “Take this to the gentleman at the inn near Astley Priors. He will give you ten shillings.” The handwriting was Tuppence’s. Tommy appreciated her quick-wittedness in realizing that he might be staying at the inn under an assumed name.
